<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 4:22">Ib. IV, 22</cite> <cite ref="M03050"><he>מְתִיבַת</he></cite> (constr.); a. e.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:14">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ דר׳ אפס</he> the college of R. E.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ דרקיעא</he> the heavenly session (of the departed scholars).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:7">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>וכולהו מ׳ דרקיעא וכ׳</he> and all those participating in the heavenly session declared &c.

senses.gloss: the proceedings at college, subject of discussions.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:21">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>מסיים מ׳ דיומא לרבנן</he> he finished up (reviewed) the subject discussed that day before the scholars.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:21">Ib.</cite> <he>ליעיין מר במוֹתִ׳ דלמחר</he> study carefully the subject of discussion for to-morrow; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְתִיבָאתָא</he>, <cite ref="M03050"><he>מְתִיבָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 6a:9">Gitt. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דאיכא מ׳</he> because there are colleges (in Babylonia).
<cite ref="Gittin 6a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ בגירסייהו וכ׳</he> the colleges are engrossed in their theoretical studies.
